exam_facts.test: Multiple well-defined, brown, greasy plaques of varying sizes noted on the forehead.
No erythema or edema around the lesions.
Lesions are slightly raised above the skin surface.
Dermatoscopy shows a network of cerebriform patterns without evidence of melanocytic activity.

exam_facts.result: Hyperkeratosis with horn cysts, consistent with seborrheic keratosis.

exam_facts.test: Total body skin examination with dermoscopy of all melanocytic lesions
exam_facts.result: No atypical melanocytic lesions identified; 12 benign-appearing nevi (all <6 mm, symmetric, uniform pigment, no dermatoscopic atypia); no lesion with asymmetry, irregular border, color variegation, or diameter >6 mm

exam_facts.test: Skin biopsy of a separate non-forehead pigmented lesion (left upper back, 4 mm diameter, stable for 5 years)
exam_facts.result: Compound melanocytic nevus with maturation, no cytologic atypia or mitotic activity
Mild degenerative disc disease at C5–C6; no osseous lesion or soft tissue mass

Liver: homogeneous echotexture, no focal mass; gallbladder: normal wall thickness, no stones; kidneys: bilateral, normal size and echogenicity, no hydronephrosis or mass; spleen: normal size and echotexture; no abdominal lymphadenopathy
